title: Dev Report v2 (nested producer shape)
description: Per-task dev implementation report, v2: matches the REAL nested producer template (agents/dev.md:590-674 — nested dev.status, top-level baseline keys) instead of v1's flat shape. Required baseline_head_sha/baseline_dirty_snapshot mirror the live producer checks at scripts/aggregate-dev-report.py:529-546 (commit inventory #71/#72, close #20/#22; empty string is legal for both — unborn repo / clean tree). The AC-deviation sub-shape is copied from its canonical machine-shape definition at scripts/resolve-dev-artifact-chain.py:80-130. lane/lane_set follow docs/reference/close-commit-zero-failure-mechanism-20260928.md §1.1(e)/§1.2: lane_set is required non-null when lane is a string; lane-membership (lane ∈ lane_set) is NOT expressible in Draft7 and is the later G2 echo check, deliberately not faked here. Authority: design §1.6 (schema v2 cutover).

baseline_head_sha.description: git rev-parse HEAD at dispatch time; empty string legal (unborn repo, agents/dev.md:595).

baseline_dirty_snapshot.description: git status --porcelain at dispatch time; key REQUIRED, value may be "" (scripts/aggregate-dev-report.py:543-546 / commit #72).

owned_edits.description: Per-file ledger of {old, new} edits authored by this cycle (schemas/owned-edits-ledger.v1.json documents the entry shape).

pre_edit_snapshots.description: Per-file pre-edit trust anchor (git blob SHA or literal pre-edit content).

status.description: The REAL nested template enum (agents/dev.md:604) — NOT v1's flat enum with 'partial'.

status_rationale.description: Required when dev.status == 'needs_review' (honest-terminal conditional, design §1.4.2; same shape as dev-report.v1.json:33-44).

ac_deviation_with_user_need_satisfied_bl.description: Canonical machine shape: scripts/resolve-dev-artifact-chain.py:80-130 ('THE ONE PLACE that defines the machine shape'). Unknown extra keys tolerated (resolver comment :96-97).
